source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine commissioning and the promise as the apostolic message's horizon.
verses.before: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through God’s will, according to the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,
verses.after: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,
verses.tsw_comparator: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God according to the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,

verses.rationale: Retains affection, kinship and threefold blessing.
verses.before: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.after: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.tsw_comparator: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.rationale: Keeps ancestral continuity, conscience and unceasing remembrance.
verses.before: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as my ancestors did, as I remember you constantly in my prayers night and day.
verses.after: I thank God, whom I serve as my ancestors did, with a clean conscience, as I constantly remember you in my prayers night and day.
verses.tsw_comparator: I give thanks to God, whom I serve with a clear conscience, as my ancestors did, when I remember you constantly in my prayers night and day,

verses.rationale: Preserves grief remembered and anticipated joy.
verses.before: Remembering your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
verses.after: Remembering your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
verses.tsw_comparator: longing to see you, recalling your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,

verses.rationale: Keeps both women by name and the dwelling metaphor across generations.
verses.before: I am reminded of the sincere trust that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am convinced, lives in you too.
verses.after: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am convinced, lives in you as well.
verses.tsw_comparator: remembering your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and now, I am convinced, dwells in you as well.

verses.rationale: Retains rekindling image, gift and embodied commissioning.
verses.before: For this reason I remind you to rekindle God’s gift that is in you through the laying on of my hands.
verses.after: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame God's gift that is in you through the laying on of my hands.
verses.tsw_comparator: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands,

verses.rationale: Preserves the contrast and all three positive qualities.
verses.before: For God did not give us a spirit of cowardice but of power, love, and self-control.
verses.after: For God did not give us a spirit of cowardice, but of power, love and self-control.
verses.tsw_comparator: for God gave us not a spirit of fear, but of power and love and self-control.

verses.rationale: Keeps imprisonment, shared suffering and divine capacity.
verses.before: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord or of me, his prisoner. Instead, share in suffering for the good news according to God’s power,
verses.after: So do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord or of me, his prisoner. Instead, share in suffering for the good news, relying on God's power.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord, nor of me his prisoner, but share in suffering for the good news according to the power of God,

verses.rationale: Preserves salvation/call, denial of works and pretemporal grace.
verses.before: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to his own purpose and grace. This grace was given to us in Christ Jesus before eternal times,
verses.after: He saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to his own purpose and grace, given to us in Christ Jesus before eternal times.
verses.tsw_comparator: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before the ages began,

verses.rationale: Keeps appearance, death's defeat and illumination of life.
verses.before: but has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the good news.
verses.after: This grace has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the good news.
verses.tsw_comparator: and now has been revealed through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the good news,

verses.rationale: Retains all three appointed roles.
verses.before: For this good news I was appointed a herald, apostle, and teacher.
verses.after: For this good news I was appointed a herald, apostle and teacher.
verses.tsw_comparator: for which I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher.

verses.rationale: Keeps suffering, personal trust and the deposit's direction as one plausible reading.
verses.before: This is also why I suffer these things. But I am not ashamed, because I know the one I have trusted, and I am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until that day.
verses.after: That is why I suffer these things. But I am not ashamed, because I know the one I have trusted and am convinced that he is able to guard what I entrusted to him until that day.
verses.tsw_comparator: For this reason I also suffer these things, but I am not ashamed, for I know the one in whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard what has been entrusted to me until that day.

verses.rationale: Preserves health metaphor, pattern and two Christ-located virtues.
verses.before: Hold to the pattern of sound words you heard from me, in the trust and love that are in Christ Jesus.
verses.after: Hold to the pattern of sound words you heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hold to the pattern of sound words that you have heard from me, in faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps entrusted treasure and indwelling divine help.
verses.before: Guard the good deposit entrusted to you through the Holy Spirit who lives in us.
verses.after: Guard the good deposit through the Holy Spirit who lives in us.
verses.tsw_comparator: Guard the good deposit entrusted to you, through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

verses.rationale: Retains the sweeping regional claim and both named examples.
verses.before: You know that everyone in Asia has turned away from me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
verses.after: You know that everyone in Asia turned away from me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
verses.tsw_comparator: You know that all who are in Asia turned away from me, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

verses.rationale: Keeps household blessing, repeated aid and imprisonment.
verses.before: May the Lord give mercy to Onesiphorus’ household, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chain.
verses.after: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chain.
verses.tsw_comparator: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains,

verses.rationale: Preserves named city and persistent search.
verses.before: Instead, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently for me and found me.
verses.after: Instead, when he was in Rome, he searched diligently for me and found me.
verses.tsw_comparator: but when he arrived in Rome he searched for me earnestly and found me—

verses.rationale: Keeps the doubled Lord expression, future day and named place.
verses.before: May the Lord grant him to find mercy from the Lord on that day. And you know very well how much service he rendered in Ephesus.
verses.after: May the Lord grant him mercy from the Lord on that day. And you know very well how much service he rendered in Ephesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: may the Lord grant him to find mercy from the Lord on that day—and you well know all the service he rendered at Ephesus.

verses.rationale: Retains kinship and passive divine strengthening.
verses.before: Therefore, my child, be strengthened by the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.after: You then, my child, be strengthened by the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus,

verses.rationale: Keeps four generations of transmission and multiple witnesses.
verses.before: What you heard from me in the presence of many witnesses, entrust to faithful people who will also be able to teach others.
verses.after: Entrust what you heard from me through many witnesses to faithful people who will be qualified to teach others also.
verses.tsw_comparator: and what you have heard from me through many witnesses entrust to faithful people who will be able to teach others also.

verses.rationale: Retains military identity and hardship.
verses.before: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.after: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: Share in suffering as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps entanglement and commanding officer imagery.
verses.before: No one serving as a soldier gets entangled in the affairs of ordinary life, so that they may please the one who enlisted them.
verses.after: No one serving as a soldier gets entangled in ordinary civilian affairs, so as to please the one who enlisted him.
verses.tsw_comparator: No one serving as a soldier entangles himself in civilian affairs, so that he may please the one who enlisted him.

verses.rationale: Preserves competition, rule and crown.
verses.before: Likewise, if someone competes as an athlete, they are not crowned unless they compete according to the rules.
verses.after: Likewise, an athlete is not crowned unless competing according to the rules.
verses.tsw_comparator: Likewise, an athlete is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.

verses.rationale: Keeps labor, priority and agricultural yield.
verses.before: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.
verses.after: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.
verses.tsw_comparator: The hardworking farmer ought to be the first to partake of the crops.

verses.rationale: Preserves human reflection and divine understanding together.
verses.before: Think about what I am saying, for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.
verses.after: Think about what I am saying, for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.
verses.tsw_comparator: Consider what I say, for the Lord will give you understanding in everything.

verses.rationale: Keeps resurrection, Davidic ancestry and personal stewardship.
verses.before: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, according to my good news,
verses.after: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead and descended from David, according to my good news.
verses.tsw_comparator: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, from the offspring of David, according to my good news,

verses.rationale: Preserves real imprisonment and the pointed chain wordplay.
verses.before: for which I suffer hardship, even to being chained like a criminal. But God’s word is not chained.
verses.after: For it I suffer hardship, even chains like a criminal. But God's word is not chained.
verses.tsw_comparator: for which I suffer to the point of chains like a criminal. But the word of God is not chained.

verses.rationale: Keeps endurance, election and salvation's full goal.
verses.before: For this reason I endure everything for the sake of the chosen ones, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.after: Therefore, I endure everything for the sake of the chosen, so that they too may obtain the salvation in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the chosen, so that they also may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

verses.rationale: Retains first parallel conditional promise.
verses.before: This saying is trustworthy: If we died with him, we will also live with him;
verses.after: This saying is trustworthy: If we died with him, we will also live with him;
verses.tsw_comparator: The saying is trustworthy: If we died with him, we will also live with him;

verses.rationale: Keeps promise and warning in matching clauses.
verses.before: if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he also will deny us;
verses.after: if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he will also deny us;
verses.tsw_comparator: if we endure, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he also will deny us;

verses.rationale: Preserves divine constancy and its self-related basis without making faithlessness harmless.
verses.before: if we are faithless, he remains faithful, because he cannot deny himself.
verses.after: if we are unfaithful, he remains faithful, for he cannot deny himself.
verses.tsw_comparator: if we are faithless, he remains faithful—for he cannot deny himself.

verses.rationale: Keeps formal warning and destructive effect.
verses.before: Remind them of these things, solemnly warning them before God not to fight about words, which is useful for nothing and ruins those who listen.
verses.after: Remind them of these things, solemnly warning them before the Lord not to fight over words. Such arguments do no good and ruin those who listen.
verses.tsw_comparator: Remind them of these things, charging them before God not to quarrel about words, which is of no value but only ruins the hearers.

verses.rationale: Retains tested laborer and difficult straight-cutting metaphor.
verses.before: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, handling the word of truth straight.
verses.after: Make every effort to present yourself to God as approved, a worker with no cause for shame who cuts the word of truth straight.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be diligent to present yourself approved to God, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.

verses.rationale: Keeps avoidance and ironic progress.
verses.before: But avoid godless empty talk, because it will advance toward greater ungodliness,
verses.after: Avoid profane empty chatter, for those who engage in it will advance into greater ungodliness,
verses.tsw_comparator: But avoid irreverent empty talk, for it will lead people into more and more ungodliness,

verses.rationale: Preserves bodily disease image and both names.
verses.before: and their word will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
verses.after: and their talk will spread like gangrene. Hymenaeus and Philetus are among them.
verses.tsw_comparator: and their message will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

verses.rationale: Keeps target-missing, false timing and real damage.
verses.before: who have departed from the truth, saying the resurrection has already happened, and they are overturning the trust of some.
verses.after: They have missed the mark concerning the truth, saying the resurrection has already happened, and they overturn the faith of some.
verses.tsw_comparator: who have swerved from the truth, saying that the resurrection has already happened, and they upset the faith of some.

verses.rationale: Preserves foundation, seal and both quotations.
verses.before: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who belong to him,” and, “Let everyone who names the Lord’s name turn away from unrighteousness.”
verses.after: Nevertheless, God's firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let everyone who names the Lord's name turn away from unrighteousness.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Nevertheless, the firm foundation of God stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let everyone who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

verses.rationale: Keeps material range and opposed purposes.
verses.before: In a large house there are not only gold and silver vessels but also wooden and clay ones, some for honorable use and some for dishonorable.
verses.after: In a large house there are not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay; some are for honorable use and some for dishonorable use.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and silver but also of wood and clay, some for honor and some for dishonor.

verses.rationale: Preserves vessel metaphor, cleansing and three results.
verses.before: Therefore, if anyone cleanses themselves from these things, they will be a vessel for honorable use, made holy, useful to the Master, prepared for every good work.
verses.after: Therefore, if anyone cleanses themselves from these things, they will be a vessel for honorable use—made holy, useful to the master and prepared for every good work.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore if anyone cleanses himself from these things, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, useful to the Master, prepared for every good work.

verses.rationale: Keeps flight/pursuit and communal setting.
verses.before: Flee youthful desires, but pursue righteousness, trust, love, and peace together with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
verses.after: Flee youthful desires and pursue righteousness, faith, love and peace, together with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: So flee youthful desires and pursue righteousness, faith, love, peace, along with those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.

verses.rationale: Retains intellectual evaluation and birth image.
verses.before: Reject foolish and ignorant controversies, knowing they produce fights.
verses.after: Reject foolish and ignorant controversies, knowing that they breed quarrels.
verses.tsw_comparator: But refuse foolish and ignorant controversies, knowing that they generate strife.

verses.rationale: Keeps slave status and three nonviolent teaching qualities.
verses.before: The Lord’s servant must not fight but must be gentle toward everyone, able to teach, patient when wronged,
verses.after: The Lord's slave must not quarrel but must be gentle toward everyone, able to teach and patient when wronged,
verses.tsw_comparator: And the servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome but kind to everyone, able to teach, patient,

verses.rationale: Preserves correction, humility and divine gift.
verses.before: correcting opponents with gentleness. Perhaps God may grant them repentance leading to knowledge of the truth,
verses.after: correcting opponents with gentleness, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to knowledge of the truth
verses.tsw_comparator: correcting opponents with gentleness. God may perhaps grant them repentance leading to the knowledge of the truth,

verses.rationale: Keeps sobriety, trapping and war-captive images.
verses.before: and they may come to their senses and escape the devil’s trap, having been captured by him to do his will.
verses.after: and that they may come to their senses and escape the devil's trap, having been captured alive by him to do his will.
verses.tsw_comparator: and they may come to their senses and escape from the snare of the devil, having been captured by him to do his will.

verses.rationale: Retains temporal frame and severity.
verses.before: Know this: difficult times will come in the last days.
verses.after: Know this: difficult times will come in the last days.
verses.tsw_comparator: But understand this: that in the last days difficult times will come.

verses.rationale: Keeps compound love terms and complete first list.
verses.before: For people will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, slanderous, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,
verses.after: For people will be self-loving, money-loving, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to parents, ungrateful and unholy,
verses.tsw_comparator: For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,

verses.rationale: Preserves every relational and moral descriptor.
verses.before: without natural affection, irreconcilable, malicious gossips, without self-control, brutal, not loving what is good,
verses.after: without natural affection, unwilling to reconcile, slanderous, without self-control, brutal and hating what is good,
verses.tsw_comparator: without natural affection, irreconcilable, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love for good,

verses.rationale: Keeps three traits and the love contrast.
verses.before: traitors, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
verses.after: treacherous, reckless, conceited, loving pleasure rather than loving God,
verses.tsw_comparator: treacherous, reckless, swollen with conceit, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

verses.rationale: Preserves appearance/reality contrast and distancing command.
verses.before: holding to an appearance of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such people.
verses.after: holding an outward form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such people.
verses.tsw_comparator: having the appearance of godliness but denying its power. Avoid such people.

verses.rationale: Keeps predatory intrusion and the source's disparaging diminutive without obscuring victimization.
verses.before: For among them are those who slip into households and captivate vulnerable women burdened with sins and driven by various desires,
verses.after: For among them are those who creep into households and capture vulnerable women burdened with sins and led by various desires,
verses.tsw_comparator: For among them are those who creep into households and capture weak women burdened with sins and led astray by various desires,

verses.rationale: Retains the perpetual learning/never arriving contrast.
verses.before: always learning yet never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
verses.after: always learning yet never able to come to knowledge of the truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

verses.rationale: Keeps traditional names, Moses comparison and failed test.
verses.before: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these people also oppose the truth—people corrupted in mind and rejected concerning the faith.
verses.after: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these people oppose the truth—people corrupted in mind and disqualified regarding the faith.
verses.tsw_comparator: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth—people corrupted in mind and disqualified regarding the faith.

verses.rationale: Preserves limit and public exposure.
verses.before: But they will not advance much further, because their foolishness will become clear to everyone, just as happened with those men.
verses.after: But they will not advance much further, for their folly will be obvious to everyone, just as the folly of those two became obvious.
verses.tsw_comparator: But they will not progress further, for their folly will be evident to all, as theirs also was.

verses.rationale: Keeps the complete sevenfold example.
verses.before: But you have followed my teaching, way of life, purpose, trust, patience, love, endurance,
verses.after: But you have followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love and endurance,
verses.tsw_comparator: But you have followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

verses.rationale: Retains all three cities, repeated persecution and deliverance.
verses.before: persecutions, and sufferings—what happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra, what persecutions I endured. Yet the Lord rescued me from them all.
verses.after: as well as my persecutions and sufferings—what happened to me in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, the persecutions I endured. Yet the Lord rescued me from them all.
verses.tsw_comparator: persecutions, sufferings—such as happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, and at Lystra—which persecutions I endured; yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.

verses.rationale: Keeps the sweeping prediction and Christ setting.
verses.before: Indeed, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
verses.after: Indeed, all who want to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
verses.tsw_comparator: Indeed, all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,

verses.rationale: Preserves active/passive deception and moral decline.
verses.before: But evil people and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
verses.after: But evil people and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
verses.tsw_comparator: while evil people and impostors will go on from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

verses.rationale: Keeps continuity, conviction and plural teachers.
verses.before: But you, continue in the things you learned and became convinced of, knowing from whom you learned them,
verses.after: But you, continue in what you learned and became convinced of, knowing from whom you learned it,
verses.tsw_comparator: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have firmly believed, knowing from whom you learned it,

verses.rationale: Retains infancy, writings and their instrumental ability.
verses.before: and how from infancy you have known the sacred writings, which are able to make you wise for salvation through trust in Christ Jesus.
verses.after: and how from infancy you have known the sacred writings, which can make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: and how from childhood you have known the sacred writings, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps God-breathed predicate and all four uses while allowing the punctuation alternative in a note.
verses.before: All Scripture is God-breathed and useful for teaching, for correction, for setting things right, and for training in righteousness,
verses.after: Every Scripture is God-breathed and useful for teaching, rebuke, correction and training in righteousness,
verses.tsw_comparator: All Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness,

verses.rationale: Preserves fitness and complete preparation.
verses.before: so that the person of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.
verses.after: so that the person of God may be capable, fully equipped for every good work.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that the person of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.

verses.rationale: Keeps judicial role, both human groups and two future realities.
verses.before: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus, who is going to judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:
verses.after: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus, who is going to judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:
verses.tsw_comparator: I solemnly charge you in the presence of God and Christ Jesus, who is to judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:

verses.rationale: Retains urgency in all seasons and three speaking actions.
verses.before: proclaim the word; be ready in season and out of season; correct, rebuke, and encourage with all patience and teaching.
verses.after: Proclaim the word; be ready when the time is favorable or unfavorable; correct, rebuke and encourage, with complete patience and teaching.
verses.tsw_comparator: preach the word; be ready in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort, with all patience and teaching.

verses.rationale: Keeps health metaphor, bodily itch and self-selected authorities.
verses.before: For a time will come when people will not tolerate sound teaching, but according to their own desires they will accumulate teachers for themselves because they have itching ears.
verses.after: For a time will come when people will not tolerate sound teaching. Instead, with itching ears and according to their own desires, they will accumulate teachers for themselves.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the time will come when people will not endure sound teaching, but having itching ears they will gather teachers for themselves according to their own desires,

verses.rationale: Preserves the matched turning actions.
verses.before: They will turn their hearing away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
verses.after: They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
verses.tsw_comparator: and will turn away their hearing from the truth and turn aside to myths.

verses.rationale: Keeps four direct commands and vocational terms.
verses.before: But you, be sober in everything, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
verses.after: But you, remain sober in everything, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist and fulfill your ministry.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you, be sober in all things, endure suffering, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.

verses.rationale: Retains sacrificial pouring and departure metaphor.
verses.before: For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time of my departure has arrived.
verses.after: For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time of my departure has arrived.
verses.tsw_comparator: For I am already being poured out as a drink offering, and the time of my departure has come.

verses.rationale: Preserves athletic/military sequence and all three completed claims.
verses.before: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the trust.
verses.after: I have fought the good fight, finished the race and kept the faith.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

verses.rationale: Keeps crown, judge and inclusive future award.
verses.before: From now on the crown of righteousness is reserved for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give me on that day—and not only to me but also to all who have loved his appearing.
verses.after: From now on, the crown of righteousness is reserved for me. The Lord, the righteous judge, will award it to me on that day—and not only to me, but also to all who have loved his appearing.
verses.tsw_comparator: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me but also to all who have loved his appearing.

verses.rationale: Retains urgency and personal need.
verses.before: Make every effort to come to me soon,
verses.after: Make every effort to come to me soon,
verses.tsw_comparator: Make every effort to come to me soon,

verses.rationale: Preserves all names, destinations and the motive attributed only to Demas.
verses.before: because Demas, having loved the present age, deserted me and went to Thessalonica; Crescens went to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
verses.after: because Demas deserted me, having loved the present age, and went to Thessalonica. Crescens went to Galatia and Titus to Dalmatia.
verses.tsw_comparator: for Demas, having loved the present age, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica; Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

verses.rationale: Keeps Luke's solitude and Mark's changed usefulness.
verses.before: Luke alone is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me for ministry.
verses.after: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me in ministry.
verses.tsw_comparator: Luke alone is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for ministry.

verses.rationale: Retains name, action and destination.
verses.before: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
verses.after: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: Tychicus I have sent to Ephesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps all concrete items, person and place.
verses.before: When you come, bring the cloak I left with Carpus at Troas, and the books—especially the parchments.
verses.after: When you come, bring the cloak I left with Carpus at Troas, as well as the scrolls, especially the parchments.
verses.tsw_comparator: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, also the scrolls, especially the parchments.

verses.rationale: Retains identity, real harm and entrusts repayment to the Lord.
verses.before: Alexander the coppersmith did me great harm. The Lord will repay him according to his works.
verses.after: Alexander the metalworker did me great harm. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
verses.tsw_comparator: Alexander the coppersmith did me great harm; the Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

verses.rationale: Keeps prudent warning and reason.
verses.before: You also watch out for him, because he strongly opposed our words.
verses.after: You too should watch out for him, because he strongly opposed our words.
verses.tsw_comparator: You also beware of him, for he strongly opposed our words.

verses.rationale: Preserves abandonment and explicit nonretaliatory prayer.
verses.before: At my first defense no one stood with me; everyone deserted me. May it not be counted against them.
verses.after: At my first defense no one came to stand with me; everyone deserted me. May it not be counted against them.
verses.tsw_comparator: At my first defense no one came to stand by me, but all deserted me. May it not be counted against them.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine presence, universal hearing and dangerous animal image.
verses.before: But the Lord stood beside me and strengthened me, so that through me the proclamation might be fully accomplished and all the Gentiles might hear. And I was rescued from the lion’s mouth.
verses.after: But the Lord stood beside me and strengthened me, so that through me the proclamation might be fully made and all the nations might hear. And I was rescued from the lion's mouth.
verses.tsw_comparator: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear; and I was rescued from the lion’s mouth.

verses.rationale: Retains confidence, heavenly destination and doxology.
verses.before: The Lord will rescue me from every evil work and save me for his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.after: The Lord will rescue me from every evil deed and bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: The Lord will rescue me from every evil deed and bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.rationale: Keeps both named coworkers and household.
verses.before: Greet Prisca and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.after: Greet Prisca and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.tsw_comparator: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

verses.rationale: Retains names, places and unresolved illness.
verses.before: Erastus remained in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.
verses.after: Erastus remained in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.
verses.tsw_comparator: Erastus remained at Corinth, and I left Trophimus ill at Miletus.

verses.rationale: Keeps seasonal urgency and every named greeter.
verses.before: Make every effort to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers and sisters.
verses.after: Make every effort to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all the brothers and sisters greet you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Make every effort to come before winter. Eubulus sends greetings to you, and Pudens and Linus and Claudia and all the brothers and sisters.

verses.rationale: Preserves singular personal blessing followed by plural community blessing.
verses.before: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
verses.after: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with all of you.
verses.tsw_comparator: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
